name: EB-3 (Skilled Worker / Professional / Other Worker)

requirements.blocker_text: This requires a permanent, full-time job offer and PERM labor certification.
requirements.fix_path: Obtain PERM labor certification through the sponsoring employer.

requirements.blocker_text: This covers three sub-categories: skilled workers (2+ years experience/training), professionals (bachelor's degree required for the role), and 'other workers' (unskilled, non-temporary).

outcome.duration_length: indefinite — leads directly to a green card (LPR status) on approval

sources.title: Employment-Based Immigration: Third Preference EB-3 - USCIS

notes: Backlogs confirmed via Aug 2026 Visa Bulletin Final Action Dates: EB-3 China ~Jan 8, 2022; EB-3 India Jan 15, 2015 (genuinely the longest-standing backlog figure in this dataset — over a decade old); Philippines Jan 1, 2024; All Areas/Mexico Current. 'Other worker' sub-category has its own, typically slower-moving, numerically-capped allocation within EB-3 — a real internal complexity not modeled as a separate group here given scope. EB-2/EB-3 'porting' (switching categories when one moves faster) is common strategy — not a schema mechanic but a genuine practical link to us_eb2.
